description.value: Clover Point is a prominent coastal headland on Victoria's southern waterfront, managed by the City of Victoria and sitting along the Dallas Road seafront corridor. It is a popular stop for cyclists riding the waterfront route, offering open views across the Strait of Juan de Fuca toward the Olympic Mountains. The exposed grassy point is well known locally as a prime spot for kite flying and watching marine traffic.
